findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Matrix/Order.lean:359`: `instance instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus [DecidableEq n]` — `CFC.sqrt S` for `S : Matrix ι ι 𝕜` depends on that instance, and `isHermitian_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt` is the only declaration in Sqrt.lean without a `[DecidableEq ι]` binder.
findings.fix: Drop `open scoped Classical in` and add `[DecidableEq ι]` to the binder list, matching `inner_toEuclideanLin_toEuclideanLin` and `PosSemidef.det_one_sub_smul_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt`.
findings.issue: `open scoped Classical in` supplies the `DecidableEq ι` that `CFC.sqrt` needs, so the statement of `isHermitian_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt` contains `Classical.propDecidable`-derived instances; every consumer (QuadraticForm.lean:198, 215) has a real `[DecidableEq ι]` in scope, so the rewrites there succeed only through instance defeq, unlike the sibling lemmas in the same file.

findings.evidence: QuadraticForm.lean:205-206 and 219-220 are character-for-character identical `simp only` invocations.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Analysis/Matrix/Order.lean:62` `protected alias ⟨LE.le.posSemidef, PosSemidef.nonneg⟩ := nonneg_iff_posSemidef`; the same projection chain appears at Sqrt.lean:60, QuadraticForm.lean:206 and QuadraticForm.lean:220.
findings.fix: State it once in Sqrt.lean (e.g. `Matrix.isHermitian_sqrt : (CFC.sqrt S).IsHermitian`, proved from `(CFC.sqrt_nonneg S).posSemidef.1`) and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: The reusable fact `(CFC.sqrt S)ᴴ = CFC.sqrt S` is spelled inline as the term `(Matrix.LE.le.posSemidef (CFC.sqrt_nonneg S)).1.eq` in three places: Sqrt.lean:60 and QuadraticForm.lean:206, 220.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and automation-friendly, but a reusable fact (`(CFC.sqrt S)ᴴ = CFC.sqrt S`) and a whole transport step are re-derived inline in three places, and `isHermitian_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt` bakes `Classical.propDecidable` into its statement so consumers match it only through instance defeq.
